name: 96826 · Honolulu, HI
findings: ZIP 96826 (Honolulu) has 142 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 44 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 96826 (Honolulu) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.
